# sanity_dataset (Data Source)

Reads information about an existing Sanity.io dataset within a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing dataset
data "sanity_dataset" "prod" {
  project_id = "your-project-id"
  name       = "production"
}

output "is_dataset_public" {
  value = data.sanity_dataset.prod.acl_mode == "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the dataset (e.g. `production`).
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Sanity project to which the dataset belongs.

### Read-Only

- `acl_mode` (String) The ACL mode of the dataset (`public` or `private`).
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the dataset was created.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `<project_id>/<dataset_name>`.
